extra.message: User-controlled query parameter 'username' (declared on line 8 as a function argument, which FastAPI binds to the request query string) is concatenated directly into a Jinja2 template string passed to Jinja2.from_string(...).render(). Because Jinja2 compiles and evaluates the template, an attacker can submit a payload such as ?username={{7*7}} or access Python object internals (e.g. {{ ''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__() }}) to achieve Server-Side Template Injection leading to Remote Code Execution. The Environment() is also created without any sandboxing (no SandboxedEnvironment, no autoescape).

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

extra.message: The unsanitized user input 'username' flows into Jinja2 template rendering, which dynamically compiles and executes the template. This constitutes code injection: an attacker can break out of the template context and execute arbitrary Python code on the server.

The rendered output, which includes unescaped user-controlled input from the 'username' query parameter, is returned directly as an HTMLResponse. The Jinja2 Environment is created without autoescape=True, so HTML/JavaScript supplied in 'username' (e.g. ?username=<script>alert(1)</script>) is reflected back to the browser unescaped, resulting in reflected Cross-Site Scripting.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation (Cross-site Scripting)
